market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. CPI release and Fed Sept 16 decision dominate. Iran conflict keeps oil/diesel elevated, pressuring inflation. Dow futures soft but AI names (Nvidia, Micron, Sandisk) flash buy signals. Expect 2-3% VIX spike into CPI. Bond yields volatile at both ends. Crypto (XRP) tests $1.43 resistance pre-Fed.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive for AI infrastructure, semiconductors, and EM financials. Memory cycle upturn supports Korean equities. TSMC $3T trajectory intact. Data center buildout and on-device AI create multi-year capex cycle. However, trade wars (Canada, tariffs) and geopolitical fragmentation cap multiples. Wage-inflation gap risks stagflationary drift if energy prices persist.
